purpose: Vite entry point — mounts the React tree via ReactDOM.createRoot with StrictMode.
Root orchestrator — owns all top-level state, calls every hook, and renders the full UI tree; wraps with AuthProvider + Vercel analytics.
notes: v0.41: BillingProvider now mounted inside AuthProvider (F-300) and PricingPanel reads useBilling().tier (F-315). resultsReady gate is the anti-reshuffle guard (v.31).

purpose: Admin console shell with two tabs — F1 Score Explainer and F2 Gold-Set Harness — gated by isAdmin().
F1 admin tool — debug-mode search showing ranked results with expandable BM25F/RRF score breakdowns and gate dispositions.
F2 admin tool — localStorage-backed gold-set regression harness computing nDCG@10/MRR/Recall metrics with run-to-run diff.
notes: Stores data in bare localStorage keys outside the opencite: namespace.

purpose: Inline brand tooltip — eagle image + speech bubble, auto-dismisses after 4s or on any click.
Client-side facet filter bar — sort, type, language (dropdown with counts), topics, year range, OA-only, derived from live sectionStates.
External archive launcher panel — groups 23 launchers by region into collapsible details elements with pre-filled search links.
Top-level layout sub-components: Header (nav + logo + ticker), ThemeStrip, Footer, KofiOverlay, AuthModal, ConnectCard, AuthButton.
notes: Apple + Microsoft OAuth providers in AuthButton are dead UI (rendered as disabled). AuthModal has no focus trap.

purpose: Four side panels (Settings, History, Library, Pricing) + AddJournalForm + SourcesPanel sub-components; LibraryPanel supports multi-format export.
notes: currentPlan hardcoded 'free' in PricingPanel. confirm() used for destructive action. Stale comment re: slider/search-toggles location.

purpose: Single search result display — title/authors/abstract, enrichment metadata, citation accordion (MLA 9 + APA 7), ★ save, EagleTooltip on first save.
Always-visible relevance controls under the search bar: Lexical↔Semantic RRF slider + 'Search settings' disclosure (layout toggle, semantic/synonym/author/simpleSearch toggles).
Sticky search bar with cycling placeholder (3.5s), Enter-to-search, and 'Search →' button — blurred backdrop, bleeds to viewport edges.
Compact in-progress/done status bar for unified view — shows loading source count, auto-hides 2s after all settle.
Per-adapter result section (source view) with book-chapter grouping, 'loose match' badge, and per-adapter load-more.
Cross-adapter ranked result list (unified view) — pools all sections, sorts by _score, paginates by group (20+10), triggers remote load-more when local pool exhausted.
Fan-out search engine — fires all enabled adapters in parallel, runs cross-adapter dedup + BM25F scoring + confidence gate, manages sectionStates.
notes: No AbortController — stale adapter responses from a superseded search can land in state.

purpose: Auth-aware settings — localStorage read/write + DB sync on sign-in; manages adapter enable/disable; one-time v.31 migration.
Auth-aware saved library — localStorage + DB sync on sign-in; toggle (add/remove), clear, isInLibrary check.
Auth-aware search history — localStorage + DB sync on sign-in; add (dedup+cap at 50), remove, clear.
notes: v0.41 (R-300): shared localStorage↔DB plumbing extracted to hooks.useSyncedStore; only history-specific mutations remain here.

purpose: Shared localStorage↔DB sync plumbing for the auth-aware hooks — load-on-mount, sync-from-DB on sign-in (DB wins), first-time push, and fire-and-forget mutation writes. Shapes injected via a config object.
notes: v0.41 (R-300): extracted from the identical 4-step sync pattern in useHistory/useLibrary/useSettings.

purpose: Parent-work header for a cluster of book chapters (chapter-count badge, year, container title, editors, publisher). Shared by SourceSection and UnifiedResultList.
notes: v0.41 (R-301/F-314): extracted from the verbatim-duplicated header block in SourceSection and UnifiedResultList.

purpose: Pure memoized derivation of filteredSections from sectionStates — applies global low-confidence gate, all facet filters, and sort.
Theme state — reads localStorage + OS preference, follows system dark-mode changes when no manual override is stored.
notes: v0.41 (F-309): LIGHT_DEFAULT now aliases the imported DEFAULT_THEME from themes.js (SSOT); DARK_DEFAULT stays 'oled'.

purpose: Eagle tooltip lifecycle — show (with optional one-time localStorage flag), dismiss, and props bundle for EagleTooltip component.
Live auth context — resolves Auth.js v5 session on mount, exposes user/status/signIn/signOut; Phase 4 hook point for SIWE wallet auth.

Billing context — exposes the signed-in user's credits + tier. Mounted in App.jsx (v0.41); fetches GET /api/credits on sign-in, falls back to Infinity/'free' stub when anonymous or on error. deduct() is still a no-op (spend stays server-side).
notes: v0.41 (F-300): mounted + wired to /api/credits. Real credit gating remains server-side (api/_shared/billing.js). Spend-side deduct() wiring is v0.42 (F-311).

purpose: Thin wrapper context for useSettings — provided SettingsProvider and useSettingsContext, but neither was ever mounted or consumed.
notes: Quarantined + deleted in v0.41 (F-301/F-308) — never mounted, never consumed. Dossier: 99-Archive/_quarantine/context-settings.md.

purpose: Factory function createLauncher() — enforces the launcher object shape (id, name, tagline, region, archiveType, contentType, buildUrl).
Registry of 23 external archive launchers (no queryable API — opens pre-filled search in new tab), grouped by region.
localStorage-backed search history CRUD — add (dedup+cap at HISTORY_MAX=50), remove, load, clear.
localStorage-backed library CRUD — add/remove/has/load/clear, keyed by DOI or source:id.
Namespaced localStorage wrapper — prefixes all keys with 'opencite:'; get/set/remove with JSON serialization and try/catch.
Utility functions: reconstructAbstract (OpenAlex inverted index), truncate (word-boundary safe), stripHtml.
Runtime platform detection (web/ios/android) — routes subscription checkout to Stripe or IAP; reads window.__OPENCITE_PLATFORM__ or Capacitor.
Client-side ring buffer logger (500 entries) — structured [opencite:adapter:event] format; installDebugLog() activates buffering + global error handlers for admins.
notes: Buffer only active when installDebugLog() is called (admin sign-in). Distinct from api/_shared/log.js (server-side).

purpose: Client-side admin gate — isAdmin(user) checks user.email against VITE_ADMIN_EMAILS env var (comma-separated).
Theme definitions — 3 themes (tan/blueGrey/oled) with full token sets for bg, fg, border, surface, accent, eagle blend, sticky-bg, title color.
notes: DEFAULT_THEME exported but never imported by useTheme.js.

purpose: App identity constants — APP_VERSION (v.35), APP_NAME (OpenCITE), SEARCH_PLACEHOLDER_ITEMS (9 cycling placeholder strings).
App-wide defaults — STORAGE_NS, HISTORY_MAX, page sizes, REGION_ORDER, DEFAULT_CURATED_JOURNALS, DEFAULT_SETTINGS (all search/source/key defaults).
Display-only pricing constants — SUBSCRIPTION_PLANS (Free/Student/Pro), CREDIT_PACKS (10k/60k/300k), SOURCE_COUNT, COVERAGE_NOTE.
notes: Presentation only — authoritative billing numbers are in api/_shared/plans.js.
